_comment: TRACE-Kin v4 config: MAP-GNN (Mutation-Aware Pocket GNN). v1 GNN backbone + per-residue novelty score (||MutaPLM[r] - aa_typical_mean[aa[r]]|| / std) + pocket-attention pool + MoLFormer-XL molecular context residual (preserved from v3). prot_evo_channels=4096 because the MutaPLM parquet files use 4096-d per-residue embeddings (runtime-detected and overridden anyway). aa_typical lookup tensors are registered as model buffers (not duplicated per-residue) to avoid 85 GB OOM at this dim. SWA disabled (v3 showed 10/10 discards). patience=10 with EPOCHS=50. ChemBERT/MoLFormer dim 768.
